Subject: Re: Fwd: Production impact - surge in 5xx/429 & timeouts after today's model update

Quick triage notes (initial):
- We see increased tail latency and a correlated rise in RPC timeouts on the inference pool that received model-v3 q4. p95 token time jumped ~3-4x compared to model-v2.
- Kernel selection became non-uniform for some sequence-lengths due to q4 quant profile. That combined with KV-cache eviction patterns created temporary contention (spikes in GPU memcpy + small kernel stalls) and request-level timeouts.
- Traffic shape: a subset of customers (large batch of short requests) amplified retry behavior — many client SDKs retried aggressively, causing transient retry storms and 429s when token-per-second limits were hit.

Immediate mitigation options:
1) Rollback to model-v2 (most reliable, fastest).
2) Apply routing policy to send OptiRetail to dedicated fallback model-v2 or a smaller q2 profile variant.
3) Temporarily bump autoscale and rate-limit client-side retries via gateway policy (buy time while we root cause).

I recommend rollback for OptiRetail now and a short hotfix to quant kernel selection logic for the general rollout.

Attaching trace samples and latency CSV (see attachments).

—Markus
Sr. Perf Engineer, Serving Runtime
